text:
{
  "status": "partial",
  "rpwd_relevant_sections": [
    "Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act 2016 - Section 16: Duty of educational institutions to provide inclusive education, reasonable accommodation, and necessary support services."
  ],
  "ncte_relevant_sections": [
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p. 30): Transacting the curriculum through the total communication approach- using signs, oral, auditory, written and visual and tactile aids-for addressing the different learning styles of children.",
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p. 30): Providing adequate facility of resource persons, and frequency of support in the school such as speech therapists, occupational therapists, psychologists, physiotherapists etc.",
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p. 30): Developing assessment tools that are inclusive by design and no special efforts are needed to make separate tools."
  ],
  "identified_gaps": [
    "Gap 1: Absence of a formalized contingency or redundancy plan for academic instruction and support during the unexpected absence of the dedicated Indian Sign Language (ISL) interpreter, creating vulnerability identified in the student challenges.",
    "Gap 2: Lack of specific provision or scheduling for specialized resource room support or allied professional services (e.g., speech and language therapy) to support vocabulary and reading comprehension acquisition relative to auditory deprivation."
  ],
  "mandatory_accommodations": [
    "Dedicated qualified Indian Sign Language (ISL) interpreter for all academic instruction and school activities pursuant to RPwD Act Section 16 and NCTE/NCERT Guidelines total communication approach.",
    "Visual-first instructional materials including captioned videos, graphic organizers, and written step-by-step instructions pursuant to NCTE/NCERT Guidelines (p. 30).",
    "Note-taking support and provision of lecture notes in advance pursuant to reasonable accommodation mandates under RPwD Act Section 16.",
    "Access to digital assistive technology including digital tablets with ISL translation/dictionary applications and speech-to-text live transcription software pursuant to RPwD Act Section 16."
  ],
  "compliance_notes": "While the IEP plan correctly identifies strong visual-spatial and ISL-based supports, it exhibits gaps regarding mandatory redundancy planning during interpreter absences and structured resource room/therapeutic interventions to mitigate vocabulary and reading comprehension risks associated with severe hearing impairment."
}
